mo01expectation0001.invariant: THE EXPECTATIONS MONITOR (2026-08-13, operator 'we need to know that the things we build are working over time... an expectations monitor of each space within you kinda like the dream that tells us a history of how it came to be but knows nothing outside of itself'): each SPACE is a self-contained MONAD — ORIGIN (how it came to be), EXPECTATIONS (assertions from the RIB-debug law: verify against real bytes, never trust a report), HISTORY (does it keep working OVER TIME), and KNOWS NOTHING OUTSIDE ITSELF. As-above-so-below: the whole is a lattice of self-similar microcosms.

mo02ribdebug0002.invariant: TRUST BYTES, NOT REPORTS, OVER TIME (RIB-debug law, living): a finished piece is only 'done' when its expectation is verified against reality — a false-success is flagged, never papered over. expectations_monitor.check() records each verification in the space's history, so health is measured over time, not asserted once. A space 'keeps working' = its recent check pass-rate stays high; drift shows in the monitor, not in the narrative.
